name: AI Agents: Patterns, Principles & Practices
description: An interactive, live-updating book on Agentic Design Patterns.
author: George Kour

originalBook.title: Agentic Design Patterns: A Hands-On Guide to Building Intelligent Systems
originalBook.author: Antonio Gulli

parts.title: Introduction & Foundations
parts.description: Getting started with agentic AI systems

modules.title: About
modules.description: Attribution and source information.

modules.title: Preface
modules.description: High-level introduction to the agentic era, the book's purpose, structure, and how to use it effectively.

modules.title: Introduction - Foundations of Agentic Systems
modules.description: Understanding the shift from Generative AI to Agentic AI, and the core differences between Workflows and Agents.

modules.title: What is an Agentic Design Pattern?
modules.description: Understanding what design patterns are, how they differ from implementations and frameworks, and how to use patterns effectively in agentic systems.

parts.title: Core Workflow Patterns
parts.description: Fundamental patterns for building agent workflows

modules.title: Pattern: Prompt Chaining (Pipeline Pattern)
modules.description: Breaking down complex tasks into sequential, manageable workflows. The foundational pattern for building reliable multi-step LLM systems.

modules.title: Pattern: Routing
modules.description: Dynamically selecting between multiple potential actions based on input, state, or conditions, introducing conditional logic into agent workflows.

modules.title: Pattern: Parallelization
modules.description: Executing multiple independent operations simultaneously to improve efficiency and reduce latency in agent workflows.

modules.title: Pattern: Reflection
modules.description: Enabling agents to review, critique, and refine their own outputs through iterative self-evaluation and improvement cycles.

modules.title: Pattern: Tool Use & Execution
modules.description: Designing the Agent-Computer Interface (ACI). Best practices for tool definitions and result management.

modules.title: Pattern: Constrained Tool Use (Mask, Don't Remove)
modules.description: Managing tool availability through programmatic constraints (logit masking) rather than dynamically modifying tool definitions, preserving KV-Cache efficiency and preventing model confusion.

parts.title: Reasoning & Planning
parts.description: Enabling agents to plan and reason effectively

modules.title: Reasoning Techniques
modules.description: Core algorithms for agency: Chain-of-Thought, ReAct Loops, and Tree-of-Thought strategies.

modules.title: Pattern: Planning
modules.description: Enabling agents to create structured plans before execution, breaking down complex goals into actionable steps.

modules.title: Pattern: Prioritization
modules.description: Enabling agents to assess and rank tasks, objectives, or actions based on significance, urgency, dependencies, and criteria.

parts.title: Memory & Context Management
parts.description: Managing context windows and externalizing memory

modules.title: Memory Management
modules.description: How to manage the context window, externalize memory, and use recitation patterns to keep agents on track.

modules.title: Pattern: Persistent Task List (Recitation)
modules.description: A context engineering strategy where agents maintain a running plan and continuously append it to context to maintain goal alignment in long-horizon tasks.

modules.title: Pattern: Leverage External Memory (Filesystem as Context)
modules.description: Treating external persistent storage as an unlimited extension of the agent's working memory, enabling restorable compression and just-in-time retrieval of large data.

modules.title: Context Compression: Managing the Finite Window
modules.description: Comprehensive techniques for fitting necessary information into the LLM's finite context window through externalization, summarization, pruning, and attention manipulation.

parts.title: Multi-Agent Systems
parts.description: Scaling up with multiple agents working together

modules.title: Multi-Agent Architectures
modules.description: Scaling up: Orchestrator-Workers, Evaluator-Optimizers, and Swarm patterns.

modules.title: Pattern: Orchestrator-Worker (Coordinator)
modules.description: A central orchestrator dynamically breaks down complex goals into subtasks, delegates to specialized workers, and synthesizes results. The most common pattern for complex multi-agent tasks.

parts.title: Advanced Capabilities
parts.description: Learning, protocols, goal management, and human interaction

modules.title: Learning and Adaptation
modules.description: Enabling agents to improve their performance over time through experience, feedback, and adaptive mechanisms.

modules.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
modules.description: A standardized protocol for agents to discover, access, and interact with external tools and data sources.

modules.title: Goal Setting and Monitoring
modules.description: Establishing clear objectives and tracking progress toward goals, enabling agents to measure success and adapt strategies.

modules.title: Pattern: Exception Handling and Recovery
modules.description: Robust error handling and recovery mechanisms that enable agents to gracefully handle failures and continue operation.

modules.title: Pattern: Human-in-the-Loop
modules.description: Integrating human oversight, feedback, and decision-making into agent workflows for safety, quality, and trust.

parts.title: Knowledge & Communication
parts.description: Retrieving knowledge and enabling agent communication

modules.title: Pattern: Knowledge Retrieval (RAG)
modules.description: Enabling LLMs to access external knowledge bases through Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, and semantic search.

modules.title: Pattern: Inter-Agent Communication (A2A)
modules.description: Enabling agents to communicate, coordinate, and collaborate with each other through standardized protocols and interfaces.

parts.title: Optimization & Safety
parts.description: Optimizing performance and ensuring safe operation

modules.title: Resource-Aware Optimization
modules.description: Optimizing agent behavior considering computational, temporal, and financial resource constraints.

modules.title: Guardrails/Safety Patterns
modules.description: Implementing safety mechanisms, content filters, and compliance checks to ensure agents operate within defined boundaries.

modules.title: Evaluation and Monitoring
modules.description: Systematic assessment of agent performance, monitoring progress, and detecting operational anomalies in production environments.

modules.title: Exploration and Discovery
modules.description: Enabling agents to actively seek out novel information, uncover new possibilities, and identify unknown unknowns.
